Get ready to roll the dice and craft the perfect deck in Diceomancer, and prepare for tactical battles and strategic planning in Chrono Ark!

With this bundle, you can enjoy an additional -10% discount on top of the Steam Autumn sale. Available for one month only—don’t miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47814/

Chrono Ark is a singleplayer roguelike that combines elements from deckbuilders and party-based RPGs. Recruit, train, and build a team of unique Investigators to restore the Twisted World!

notes.title: ATTENTION! We found a crash issue
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Have you played fun on DICEOMANCER? How many fish did you get?

DICEOMANCER is our first game, we use fully hand-drawn animations on it. The animations are so cool, but they also use a lot of memory, so it may cause a crash when it's loading.

If you have a crash issue, you can try to free up disk and release memory. We are optimizing it and making the game batter. 

Apologies for everyone's bad experience, thanks for your understanding and support.

notes.title: What we could do when we met a BUG?
notes.notes:
Hey, to whom are fishing:

Have you come across some strange little bugs on your fishing journey? We've done our best to clear them out, but every now and then, some may still pop up. If you encounter any, please let us know! We'll extend the hand of programming to squash them out.

If you find any BUGs, here’s how you can report them:

1. If you run into a bug during your playthrough, the game will automatically generate an error code. Click "Report Bug," and after the page redirects, select "I want to paste the BUG code I copied in-game" and paste it into the box. It will then be sent to us!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641140/d681512349a84bef0af514dda33a881f6a1e311c.png[/img]

2. If you'd like to provide more detailed information, you can also find the little bug icon in 【Settings】. Click on it, and you'll be directed to our online form to fill in the details.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641140/5e12e9507e1b890dd48484e7776be610f82fe6d3.png[/img]
What? You can’t find the bug icon? It’s right here! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641140/a92a446192630d98d0ef973bf3e2d7b7e67eb10c.png[/img]

Or you can fill it out directly via this link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/18I27avEHIXhHMpgCZfly9RpefpN-vO9XEb8m2R5_tMI/edit?usp=sharing


If you've recorded a video showing the bug and would like to share it with us, feel free to join our DISCORD and sent it to "bug-report" group. Congratulations! You've successfully fed a bug to the  goose! 🦢🎉

notes.title: Emergency, emergency, emergency! Only one day left until the release!
notes.notes:
Hi folks, just 1 more day until we set off for the fishing adventure! Excited? Pumped? Let's get hyped! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641140/4d43ce4d5d08dce1443957426908da14702ff2aa.jpg[/img]

We've received a few questions recently, such as, "Will the demo still be available after the full release?" So here's a quick FAQ to clear up any concerns:

[b]The free demo is still available to play![/b]
On the Steam page for Diceomancer, you can still access the free demo. So, if you're unsure whether the game is enjoyable, go ahead and try out the free demo first! (Why not give it a shot, right?)

[b]Is there a big difference between the free demo and the full version?[/b]
While the core systems are the same, the card designs, animations, sound effects, and more have all been significantly improved in the full version. So, yes, the changes are pretty noticeable. Even if you've already played the free demo, we highly recommend starting from the prologue in the full version, as we've made a few tweaks to that as well!

[b]Demo save files won’t transfer to the full version.[/b]
Because there have been so many improvements between the demo and the full game, demo saves won't carry over. But don't worry—according to the Piggy, leveling up in the full version is lightning fast!

So—tomorrow at 3 PM (UTC+8), we officially launch!

FOLLOW US HERE: [url=https://x.com/Diceomancer_]X[/url] [url=https://discord.gg/3KxtqtuyUH]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Demo minor update - 0.55.0220
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed the black screen issue when continuing/starting a game due to save incompatibility.

notes.title: Demo minor update - 0.55.0219
notes.notes:
[b]Changes[/b]
- Adjusted the cards received after casting cards with the "Glitch" keyword.
- Added several new black cards.
- Modified the upgraded effects of purple "Strike" and "Block" cards.
- Crows may show non-attack intentions when there are numerous enemies.
- Slightly adjusted the behavior and initial evasion value of wolves when there are numerous enemies.
- The "Energy" card that "Chaotic Transform" generates now has the "Exert" keyword instead of "Limit."
- Increased the HP of the Pig King slightly.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed an issue where hand cards could be converted into mana during busy states.
- Re-fixed the bug where mana icons remained on the screen.
- Fixed an issue where the upgraded "Vicious Mockery" card was identical to its original version.
- Fixed an issue where pressing the collapse card button didn't work while using  the "Crossroads" card.
- Fixed an issue where the upgraded "Trick" card's effect turned into another card's effect.
- Fixed a bug that may occur after using the "Shockwave" card.
- Fixed a bug where pausing the purple mist effect became ineffective after loading a save.
- Fixed an error when subtracting identical dice numbers.
- Addressed an error that may occur when right-clicking to discard a relic.
- Fixed an issue when the layout did not update after modifying a relic.
- Fixed a bug where the scroll button in the Loot screen could not be closed.
- Fixed a bug that may occur when leaving the Loot screen.

[b]Misc[/b]
- Replaced some image assets.
- Fixed numerous localization issues.

notes.title: Demo minor update - 0.55.0216
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a bug where mana icons couldn't be cleared.
- Fixed an issue where sometimes keywords' effects could not find their targets.
- Fixed an error related to clearing VFX after a card was exerted.
- Fixed an error that occurred when clearing VFX after healing health.
- Fixed some instances where "Miracle" effects did not trigger.

[b]Misc[/b]
- Advanced the resolving order of the keyword "Choose"'s effects.

notes.title: Demo minor update - 0.55.0210
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed the damage type of the "Chip Storm" ability.

[b]Misc[/b]
- Added damage estimation display for the card "Multistrike".
- Reduced the sound effect frequency and volume for some enemies.
- Addressed some localization issues.
- Changed the game's default language when the system language is not supported.

notes.title: Demo minor update - 0.55.02.08
notes.notes:
[b]Change[/b]
- Reduced the amount at which the "Distorted" keyword accelerates the purple mist.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed an issue where certain buttons disappeared when viewing the card library after beating the game.

[b]Misc[/b]
- Addressed some localization issues.
- Updated descriptions for some cards.
- Provided more detailed explanation of the purple mist in the tutorial.

notes.title: Demo minor update - 0.55.02.07
notes.notes:
[b]New Features[/b]
- Added "Bonus" and "Limited" keywords to the card "Borrowed Card" to prevent infinite duplicates.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a freeze issue after encountering specific events more than one time.
- Fixed a bug where temporary cards would lose their temporary keyword after being reloaded or depleted.
- Corrected the issue where burn damage could be evaded (burn-like damage types are now immune to any buff / debuff / accuracy checks).
- Fixed a bug where event choices wouldn't refresh after altering the amount of gold in possession during an event.
- Fixed a calculation error that could occur when changing the number of "Dice Cheat: MAX / MIN".
- Fixed a bug where leaving the career upgrade could leave card previews on the screen.

[b]UI[/b]
- In dice mode, the button to collapse cards has been moved to the screen's edge to prevent obscuring the numbers that need to be changed.
- Settings now only display in the current language, with a gear icon indicating the settings upon selection.

[b]Misc[/b]
- Significantly lowered the volume of sound effects for career upgrades.
- Clarified descriptions for several abilities.
- Corrected numerous typo.

notes.title: Demo Minor Update - 0.55.02.06.3
notes.notes:
[b]New Features[/b]
- Added a game over event when the purple mist completely covers the map, to prevent infinite "time passes" farming.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed the bug where you couldn't see minimap in the event interface.
- Fixed the bug where the "Purify" cards were ineffective.

[b]Localization[/b]
- Ensured the game's initial localization is chosen based on the system language upon first launch.
- Language settings are now bilingual for clear changes, even if errors occur.
- Corrected some localization issues.

notes.title: Demo Minor Update - 0.55.02.06
notes.notes:
[b]New Features[/b]
1. Added support for skipping the prologue

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a bug where cards with the "Choose" keyword could get stuck on the right side of the screen after use.
- Fixed a bug where controlling the SFX volume did not affect some sound effects.
- Fixed a bug that could cause card previews to freeze in the career upgrade interface.
- Fixed a bug where changing the "Rainbow" number did not add the "Distorted" keyword to the card
- Corrected the values of the "Explosion" card
- Clarified some localization descriptions, including those for "Dice Bonus" and "Dice Penalty".
- Comprehensive adjustments to optimize gaming experience.

Thank you very much for playing! If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions while playing, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/3KxtqtuyUH]discord[/url] and let us know!

notes.title: DICEOMANCER very first free DEMO will be released on 5th Feb!
notes.notes:
As part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest, The Rogue-like card game DICEOMANCER, developed by Ultra Piggy Studio and published by Gamera Games, will be releasing a free DEMO on 5th!

In this demo, you can choose from three mana to combine for special abilities. Upon the first successful completion, new mana will be unlocked for further combinations. Create your own  battle style!

Be sure to add DICEOMANCER to your Steam Wishlist and join our [b]Discord[/b] (https://discord.gg/3KxtqtuyUH) now!

notes.title: Slay the Spire meets Baldur's Gate 3 in new Steam roguelike
notes.notes:
Slay the Spire has the intricate roguelike deck building that sees you put together powerful card combos to take on the random encounters ahead of you. Baldur's Gate 3 has the bold fantasy setting and the unquestionable thrill that comes from leaving your fate in the hands of a dice roll. Bring them together and the result is Diceomancer, a new roguelike announced at the Tokyo Game Show and heading to Steam.
